```{python}
#| label: fig-latchup
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Parasitic thyristor in a CMOS inverter, causing latch-up: the vertical PNP (PMOS source = emitter, n-well = base, substrate = collector) and the lateral NPN (NMOS source = emitter, substrate = base, n-well = collector) are cross-coupled through the well resistance $R_\\mathrm{well}$ and the substrate resistance $R_\\mathrm{sub}$. Injected charge that develops $\\approx 0.7\\,$V across either resistance triggers the loop."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, FancyArrowPatch

C = dict(sub='#f5e9d0', nwell='#aacdea', ox='#c7dff2', poly='#3e9c5c',
         nplus='#4a7fb5', pplus='#d1862c')

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.0))
SURF = 3.4

ax.add_patch(Rectangle((0, 0), 14, SURF, fc=C['sub'], ec='k', lw=0.8))
ax.text(2.4, 0.4, 'p-substrate', fontsize=9)
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((7.2, 1.2), 6.8, SURF - 1.2, fc=C['nwell'],
                       ec='k', lw=0.8))
ax.text(12.8, 1.5, 'n-well', fontsize=8)


def diff(x0, w, typ):
    fc = C['nplus'] if typ == 'n' else C['pplus']
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x0, SURF - 0.5), w, 0.5, fc=fc, ec='k',
                           lw=0.6))
    ax.text(x0 + w / 2, SURF - 0.25, f'${typ}^+$', ha='center',
            va='center', fontsize=7, color='white')


def gate(x0, w):
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x0, SURF), w, 0.12, fc=C['ox'], ec='k',
                           lw=0.4))
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x0, SURF + 0.12), w, 0.35, fc=C['poly'],
                           ec='k', lw=0.4))


# NMOS: p+ sub tie, n+ source, gate, n+ drain
diff(0.6, 1.0, 'p')
diff(2.2, 1.1, 'n')
gate(3.4, 0.7)
diff(4.2, 1.1, 'n')
# PMOS in n-well: p+ drain, gate, p+ source, n+ well tie
diff(7.8, 1.1, 'p')
gate(9.0, 0.7)
diff(9.8, 1.1, 'p')
diff(11.8, 1.0, 'n')

for x, t in [(1.1, '$V_\\mathrm{SS}$'), (2.75, 'S'), (4.75, 'D'),
             (8.35, 'D'), (10.35, 'S'), (12.3, '$V_\\mathrm{DD}$')]:
    ax.annotate(t, xy=(x, SURF + 0.55), xytext=(x, SURF + 1.15),
                fontsize=8, ha='center',
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', lw=0.7))

# parasitic transistors
ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((10.3, 2.5), (10.3, 0.9), arrowstyle='->',
                             mutation_scale=10, lw=1.4, color='#b02020'))
ax.text(10.6, 1.3, 'vertical PNP', fontsize=8, color='#b02020')
ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((7.4, 1.6), (2.9, 2.5), arrowstyle='->',
                             mutation_scale=10, lw=1.4, color='#0040a0',
                             connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.25'))
ax.text(4.2, 1.1, 'lateral NPN', fontsize=8, color='#0040a0')

# parasitic resistances
ax.plot([1.1, 1.1, 6.6], [2.9, 0.6, 0.6], color='#555555', lw=1.2,
        ls=':')
ax.text(4.6, 0.72, '$R_\\mathrm{sub}$', fontsize=8, color='#555555')
ax.plot([12.3, 12.3, 11.2], [2.9, 1.7, 1.7], color='#555555', lw=1.2,
        ls=':')
ax.text(11.1, 1.85, '$R_\\mathrm{well}$', fontsize=8, color='#555555')

ax.set_xlim(-0.2, 14.2)
ax.set_ylim(-0.3, 5.2)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
